covid19.label: COVID-19
covid19.notes: Default values reflect the ancestral-strain consensus from CDC and Imperial College reports (2020 to 2022). Cryptic pre-spread is documented (Davis 2021): SARS-CoV-2 reached Italy / Iran / France weeks before official case counts caught up, so the effective-distance pre-seeding variant fires.
citations: Liu et al. 2020 J Travel Med

flu.label: Seasonal Influenza
flu.notes: Pandemic-level seasonal flu. CFR is age-weighted population average. No cryptic pre-spread assumed: 2009 H1N1 was caught quickly in Veracruz hospitals; spread happened through travel after detection.
citations: Biggerstaff et al. 2014 BMC Infect Dis

mpox.label: Mpox (Clade IIb)
mpox.notes: 2022 outbreak parameters; transmission heterogeneity is high so this is a population-average view. No cryptic pre-spread: clinical lesions are visible, and the 2022 outbreak propagated through specific MSM social networks rather than aggregate mobility.
citations: Du et al. 2022 Lancet Reg Health Eur

ebola.label: Ebola (Zaire EBOV)
ebola.notes: Zaire ebolavirus parameters from the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak (Althaus 2014). No cryptic pre-spread: clinical syndrome is dramatic and triggers rapid surveillance once recognised. Caveat: Ebola spreads predominantly through close contact along land routes (Guinea -> Liberia -> Sierra Leone in 2014), so an air-mobility-based model under-predicts overland importation; expect lower top-K precision than for air-driven coronaviruses.

sars.label: SARS (2003)
sars.notes: 2003 SARS-CoV outbreak parameters from Lipsitch et al. 2003 Science (R0 range 2.2-3.6). No cryptic pre-spread: clinical syndrome was recognised early and triggered rapid isolation; spread was mostly via super-spreader events at hospitals and international flights, not silent community transmission.

pathogenx.label: Pathogen X (custom)
pathogenx.notes: Hypothetical novel pathogen. All parameters are user-tunable; presets are mid-range scenario. Conservative default: assume cryptic pre-spread for an unknown novel pathogen until clinical detection confirms otherwise. Origin is intentionally unset so picking this preset preserves the user's last-touched country.

dengue2050.label: Dengue (2050 climate)
dengue2050.notes: Climate-shifted dengue under an IPCC RCP 4.5 scenario. Aedes aegypti and A. albopictus suitability is projected to expand into Mediterranean Europe, US Gulf Coast, and southern Canada by 2050, putting an additional ~1 billion people in at-risk regions. Use as a thought experiment for climate-driven outbreak planning.

cholera2050.label: Cholera (2050 SST shift)
cholera2050.notes: Climate-shifted Vibrio cholerae outbreak under IPCC RCP 4.5 sea-surface-temperature warming. SST anomalies in the Bay of Bengal and East Africa coast lengthen the seasonal V. cholerae bloom and expand coastal-water suitability into formerly cooler regions, increasing seeding pressure on coastal cities.

malaria2050.label: Malaria (2050 highland warming)
malaria2050.notes: Climate-shifted Plasmodium falciparum under IPCC RCP 4.5. Documented highland warming in East African (Ethiopian, Kenyan) highlands and Andean South America places previously naive populations at risk via Anopheles arabiensis range expansion into 1500-2000 m elevations.

lyme2050.label: Lyme (2050 northward Ixodes)
lyme2050.notes: Climate-shifted Borrelia burgdorferi under IPCC RCP 4.5. Warmer winters allow Ixodes scapularis (deer tick) populations to colonise further north into Canada and the Nordic region; established US/EU range densifies.
